title: Sinai's Positive Metric Entropy Conjecture for the Chirikov Standard Map
exact_target: For a positive-measure set of parameters, does the standard map exhibit chaotic tangent growth on a positive-area set of trajectories?

sources.citation: A. Gorodetski and V. Kaloshin, "Conservative Homoclinic Bifurcations and Some Applications," Proc. Steklov Inst. Math. 267 (2009), 76-90. DOI:10.1134/S0081543809040063.
